pre_reactor_steps: Dissolve Fmoc-L-methionine and photocatalyst in acetonitrile to 0.1 M.
Pump liquid stream A and gas stream B (Air) into static mixer.
chemistry_notes: Photo-oxidation of methionine to sulfoxide. Oxygen is a reactant; deoxygenation is prohibited. Reaction is mass-transfer limited (Da >> 1), requiring efficient gas-liquid mixing. Short residence time (0.3 min) enabled by high photon flux in flow. BPR required to maintain O2 solubility.
